DIAGNOSIS READY: Disseminated Gonococcal Infection (Arthritis-Dermatitis Syndrome).

The markedly elevated white blood cell count in your joint fluid and the Gram stain showing Gram-negative diplococci, combined with your positive STI screening for Gonorrhea, confirm this infection. I will treat this immediately with appropriate antibiotics.
